subject: design/review-feedback-capture
statement: the machine projection (`effective.source.json`) is generated by `docgate fold docs/feedback/<subject-stem>` and **byte-verified in CI** (the PRD-ledger contract) — never hand-authored; a wrong projection is fixed at the entry or the fold, never the output. The fold regenerates on each entry write (capture and disposition), byte-verified by `verify-generated` in CI and a desk hook — the PRD-ledger freshness contract; a stale projection reds the gate.
